notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
